objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First, it would be good if you could try to venture west. Following that, take the sponge from the cabinet. Then, go to the east. With that over with, open the safe within the studio. After that, insert the sponge inside the safe. Alright, thanks!

quests.desc: Welcome to TextWorld! Your first objective is to take a trip west. Once you get around to doing that, retrieve the sponge from the cabinet. And if you do that, you're the winner!

Welcome to TextWorld! Here is how to play! Your first objective is to go west. After that, retrieve the sponge from the cabinet. And then, attempt to head east. Next, open the safe within the studio. And then, you can place the sponge into the safe within the studio. And once you've done that, you win!

infos.name: studio
infos.desc:
You are in a studio. A typical kind of place. You begin looking for stuff.

 You see a gleam over in a corner, where you can see a safe![if c_0 is open and there is something in the c_0] The safe contains [a list of things in the c_0]. Suddenly, you bump your head on the ceiling, but it's not such a bad bump that it's going to prevent you from looking at objects and even things.[end if][if c_0 is open and the c_0 contains nothing] The safe is empty! This is the worst thing that could possibly happen, ever![end if]

You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unguarded.

infos.desc:
You've entered a sauna.

 [if c_1 is locked]A locked[else if c_1 is open]An open[otherwise]A closed[end if] cabinet is right there by you.[if c_1 is open and there is something in the c_1] The cabinet contains [a list of things in the c_1].[end if][if c_1 is open and the c_1 contains nothing] Empty! What kind of nightmare TextWorld is this?[end if]

 There is [if d_2 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] portal leading north. There is an unblocked exit to the east.

infos.name: bathroom
infos.desc:
Of every bathroom you could have sauntered into, you had to show up in an usual one.

 You can make out a shelf. [if there is something on the s_0]On the shelf you can make out [a list of things on the s_0].[end if][if there is nothing on the s_0]Looks like someone's already been here and taken everything off it, though.[end if]

 There is [if d_0 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] door leading north. There is [if d_1 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] gateway leading west.

infos.name: restroom
infos.desc:
You are in a restroom. A standard kind of place. You decide to start listing off everything you see in the room, as if you were in a text adventure.



 There is [if d_1 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] gateway leading east. There is [if d_2 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] portal leading south.

infos.name: cookhouse
infos.desc:
Well, here we are in a cookhouse. The room is well lit.

 You can make out a cuboid locker.[if c_2 is open and there is something in the c_2] The cuboid locker contains [a list of things in the c_2]. There's something strange about this being here, but you can't put your finger on it.[end if][if c_2 is open and the c_2 contains nothing] What a letdown! The cuboid locker is empty![end if] You can make out a freezer.[if c_3 is open and there is something in the c_3] The freezer contains [a list of things in the c_3].[end if][if c_3 is open and the c_3 contains nothing] The freezer is empty! This is the worst thing that could possibly happen, ever![end if]

 There is [if d_0 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] door leading south. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, it is unguarded.
